title: MOVE WS-GROUP-A TO WS-GROUP-B — group MOVE is byte-by-byte; PIC details inside are ignored
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. GROUP-MOVE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-A.
           05  A-CODE   PIC X(4)   VALUE "ABCD".
           05  A-AMT    PIC 9(5)V99.
       01  WS-B.
           05  B-CODE   PIC X(4).
           05  B-AMT    PIC 9(5)V99 COMP-3.
      *> MOVE WS-A TO WS-B is a GROUP move -- byte-for-byte. It does
      *> NOT see that B-AMT is COMP-3 (packed) while A-AMT is DISPLAY
      *> (zoned). The bytes go through unchanged and B-AMT now holds
      *> nonsensical packed-decimal data.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE WS-A TO WS-B.
           STOP RUN.
notes: Group MOVE is a silent USAGE-mismatch bug source. A Java rewrite that does record1 = record2 actually mirrors group MOVE — but a port that maps each field via a setter respects USAGE. The spec must capture which the legacy code expects.
